name: Three Wishes
source:
Addie, Mint, and Emi were enjoying their night at a sleepover when a shooting star falls from the sky and crashes right near them!

Saty appears, promising to grant them whatever their hearts desire. The catch? They each get only one wish.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2692730/]Steam[/url]]
